description_en: Queries the details of a logical model
name: GetLogicalModel

parameters.help_en: The ID of the logical model. Use the vm- identifier returned by the API operation
parameters.help_zh: 逻辑模型 ID，使用接口返回的 vm- 标识
parameters.name: logical_model_id

code.description_en: The response status code. A value of Ok indicates success, and a specific business error code indicates failure
code.description_zh: 响应状态码。成功时返回 Ok，失败时返回具体业务错误码

data.description_en: The business result returned by the logical model operation
data.description_zh: 逻辑模型操作返回的业务结果

availablePaths.description_en: The intersection of supported paths for all primary targets
availablePaths.description_zh: 全部主目标支持路径交集

path.description_en: The call path of the model

type.description_en: The protocol type used by the call path
type.description_zh: 该调用路径使用的协议类型

availablePaths.title_en: 全部主目标支持路径交集
availablePaths.title_zh: 全部主目标支持路径交集

callStrategy.description_en: The call strategy. For the new version of Auto, valid values are balanced, cheap, fast, and quality. For legacy configurations, this can be omitted and the base name remains balanced. This is omitted for Mapping and Weighted
callStrategy.description_zh: 新版Auto返回balanced、cheap、fast或quality；旧配置可省略且基础名保持balanced；Mapping/Weighted省略
callStrategy.title_en: 新版Auto返回balanced、cheap、fast或quality；旧配置可省略且基础名保持balanced；Mapping/Weighted省略
callStrategy.title_zh: 新版Auto返回balanced、cheap、fast或quality；旧配置可省略且基础名保持balanced；Mapping/Weighted省略

deployment.description_en: The deployment. Saving the intent triggers an independent configuration delivery. Acceptance does not mean the configuration has taken effect
deployment.description_zh: 保存意图对应独立配置下发；受理不表示生效

operationId.description_en: The ID of the current shared configuration delivery

revision.description_en: The configuration revision of the object

status.description_en: The deployment status. Valid values: Pending, Running, Succeeded, PartiallyFailed, and Failed. This is not the API release status

deployment.title_en: 保存意图对应独立配置下发；受理不表示生效
deployment.title_zh: 保存意图对应独立配置下发；受理不表示生效

fallbackTargets.description_en: The ordered fallback targets. A maximum of 5 fallback targets are supported. They are deduplicated by the actual card ID and can be an empty array
fallbackTargets.description_zh: 有序备用最多5个；按实际卡ID去重，可为空数组

modelCardId.description_en: The ID of the actual source card in the same instance

fallbackTargets.title_en: 有序备用最多5个；按实际卡ID去重，可为空数组

features.description_en: The intersection of Boolean features for the primary targets

gatewayId.description_en: The ID of the instance to which the logical model belongs

logicalModelId.description_en: The ID of the independent logical model, which starts with vm-

meta.description_en: The capabilities of the primary targets

maxInputTokens.description_en: The maximum number of input tokens. The minimum value among all primary targets is used when all are known. Otherwise, this is omitted

name.description_en: The client logical call name. The name can be up to 256 bytes in UTF-8 encoding, must not contain spaces or slashes, and must not start with auto

requiresActivation.description_en: Specifies whether activation is required. This is returned only for Auto. A value of true indicates that the AI Credits Router commodity is not activated, and false indicates that it is activated. This is omitted if the read fails or the status is unknown, or for Mapping and Weighted
requiresActivation.description_zh: 仅Auto返回：AI Credits Router商品未开通为true，已开通为false；读取失败或未知时省略；Mapping/Weighted省略

routingPolicy.description_en: The routing policy. Valid values: Mapping, Weighted, and Auto. If Auto is specified, targets must be an empty array and slots is required

slots.description_en: The slots. This is returned only for Auto. Each of the simple, standard, and complex slots contains 1 to 3 source cards. The three slots are globally deduplicated by modelCardId. This is omitted for Mapping and Weighted

complex.description_zh: complex槽1至3张源卡；三槽按modelCardId全局去重
